detail.longDescription: If your instructor shares course notes as Markdown files on GitHub or Codeberg, Docsify-This can give you a better way to view them 🚀 You get a sidebar, on-page search, and a layout that works on your phone. I just put together a short guide for students getting started: https:// hibbittsdesign.org/viewing-git hub-course-notes.html Feedback welcome. # Docsify # OpenSource # GitHub # Codeberg
